title: The Great Wave Reborn in 3D
summary: A Three.js and ink-GLSL 3D diorama of Hokusai’s Great Wave with three oshiokuri-bune boats and Mount Fuji framed beneath the crest.
description: A Three.js / WebGL2 interpretation of Hokusai's Under the Wave off Kanagawa on a carved cedar base. Three oshiokuri-bune boats ride the swelling indigo water beneath curling foam claws with Mount Fuji framed inside the hollow of the breaking wave.
